mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 2% triggers an easing monetary cycle that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1000 units triggers a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak demand (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the money supply signals a tightening monetary cycle that reduces economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production and a decline in the consumer price index signals a strong supply environment with low inflation that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong supply growth with low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
